# Romewise

> > Comprehensive travel guide to Rome, Italy, covering major attractions like the Colosseum, Vatican Museums, Trevi Fountain, and Pantheon, with expert advice on dining, planning, and experiencing the Eternal City.

Romewise is authored by Rome experts Elyssa Bernard and Alessandro Bisceglie, offering insider knowledge on everything from Vatican Museums visits to Trastevere restaurants, seasonal packing guides, and hidden gems like the Protestant Cemetery. The site helps travelers plan trips to Rome and nearby Italian cities like Florence and Naples.

## Key Topics

- Rome attractions and monuments
- Vatican Museums and Sistine Chapel
- Colosseum and ancient sites
- Trevi Fountain and Pantheon
- Rome dining and restaurants
- Aperitivo and rooftop bars
- Seasonal travel planning
- Packing guides and weather
- Trastevere neighborhood
- Protestant Cemetery and unusual attractions
- 2025 Papal Jubilee
- Family travel with kids
- Tax refunds and money tips
- Day trips to Florence and Naples

## Vatican & Major Attractions

- [Visit Vatican Museums in 2025 - Pro Tips](https://www.romewise.com/visit-vatican-museums.html): Vatican Museums & Sistine Chapel visiting guide with crowd tips
- [Castel Sant Angelo Rome - Rome's history in one place](https://www.romewise.com/castel-sant-angelo-rome.html): Historical guide to Castel Sant'Angelo fortress and monument
- [Celebrate the special Papal Jubilee in Rome](https://www.romewise.com/papal-jubilee.html): Guide to 2025 Papal Jubilee celebrations and Vatican events in Rome
- [Find out how to visit the Scala Sancta in Rome](https://www.romewise.com/scala-sancta.html): Visitor guide to Holy Stairs (Scala Sancta) near Lateran Basilica
